name: ai-audiobook-generator
description: AI audiobook generator: convert EPUB and HTML to expressive, chaptered M4B audiobooks with Chatterbox TTS, reference voices, and reviewed narration. Includes a Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: EPUB to audiobook with Chatterbox TTS and chaptered M4B export
interface.longDescription: Convert EPUB and HTML books to expressive English audiobooks using local Chatterbox TTS, reference voices, and chaptered M4B export. The Codex plugin preserves source wording, directs rhetorical performance, and supports reviewed, resumable audiobook production.
defaultPrompt: Create a faithful English audiobook from my EPUB, with reviewed rhetorical direction and chaptered M4B delivery.
